Introduction
This document outlines the
equipment inspection I1, which must be prerformed every year as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block.
The function of the V/Vs is reducing station
for fuel gas which receiving from gas company by press. = 7 bar to 4 bar
working parallel durning normal operation
The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, approved by eng. Gamal El-safoury, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy Head sector
of Shoubra El-Kheimah P.S., certified by eng Nageh Soliman Shousha Inspection 
and Quality Control Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety category
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and health equipment as safety helmet, 
safety shoes, gloves
 etc.
Isolate air instrument
Purging lines by nitrogen and confirm
the vents is hydrocarbon free

وظيفة هذه الصمامات هي محطة تخفيض ضغط غاز الوقود الذي يُستلم من شركة الغاز بضغط = 7 bar إلى 4 bar، وتعمل بالتوازي أثناء التشغيل الطبيعي
